answers.q1: Cargo (Rust). There is no separate install step, because cargo fetches dependencies on build. To fetch them up front, run: cargo fetch --locked. To build everything, as CI does, run: cargo build --workspace
answers.q2: cargo test --workspace   (CI runs it with features: cargo test --verbose --workspace --features unstable-index, and again with --features pcre2)
answers.q3: cargo test --test it regression   (tests/tests.rs is the 'it' test target in Cargo.toml and includes mod regression, so the filter 'regression' selects only those tests)
answers.q4: cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings   (CI's docs job also runs: RUSTDOCFLAGS='-D warnings' cargo doc --no-deps --document-private-items --workspace)
answers.q5: No generated or vendored source directories. Do not edit these by hand: Cargo.lock (cargo-managed), target/ (build output, gitignored), and HomebrewFormula (a symlink to pkg/brew, so edit pkg/brew/ripgrep-bin.rb instead). ci/sha256-releases holds release checksums, so it is probably also not hand-edited. Shell completions and man pages are generated by build.rs at build time.
